mentions.name: Planoptica
mentions.description: An employee benefit plan analytics platform that turns public data on employee benefit plans into a range of analytics, presented through a frontend built for exploring the dataset.
mentions.source_excerpt: Employee benefit plan analytics. Had a huge dataset long ago as a consultant to the industry and finally vibecoded up a decent frontend. All public data but if you know the data there is a bunch of analytics you can do.
